correctness.rationale: PASS: Explicitly decomposed zero-sum distance-power form Q_p into global 2x2 negative P_mk/m, branch-contrast negative R_k, and leaf-contrast negative a=sum delta² sectors; dimensions total N-1 for all-vertex N=1+m+mk. The exact identity P_mk=R_k+m H_p and nonproportional Laplace Gram functions show -H_p strictly positive definite for 1<p<2. Thus global P PSD implies all other sectors PD; at p=1 P=[[2,2],[2,2+2/k]] is PD, and its first diagonal reaches zero at beta_m=log2(2m/(m-1)) while P22<0, forcing an earlier determinant zero. Every zero before beta_m has P11>0 and is PSD rank1; Li–Weston strict p-negative type inheritance rules out two distinct determinant roots. The negative rank-one perturbation in 1/k and negative definite H perturbation in m lower the threshold strictly. Endpoint nullity one, ranks N-2/N-1, and two 1/k/1/m asymptotic constants follow by eigenvalue perturbation. Direct all-vertex distance matrix quadratic-form recomputation matched the three-sector formula on 60 independently sampled weights for representative m,k,p, and roots increase/decrease as stated. Finite checks do not prove the family theorem.
